provenance.note: The organizer may announce 15 record shots instead of 20 (E.7.9). The 30 min of E.7.10 include the sighters. B.11.1 (Teil B, PDF p. 8) lists this discipline on the ISSF 25 m/50 m pistol face and B.11.3 (Teil B, PDF p. 18) lists it on BDMP-Scheibe Nr. 2 (ISSF 300 m). Chapter E.7.11 names the ISSF 25 m/50 m pistol face at 100 m, and the record follows the chapter.
